description: US Navy bureau number 76823, delivered to Alameda between February and June 1946; later a Forest Industries Flying Tankers and Coulson water bomber flying its last fire season in 2015. description: Built in Toronto in 1944, reached the UK in January 1945 without seeing combat, then converted for coastal surveillance and search and rescue until retirement in 1966. Displayed on a pylon on the Toronto lakeshore for three decades, restoration started by the Canadian Air and Space Museum in 1999, and custody awarded to this museum in late summer 2018. Under restoration.
